rationale: The committee needs an answer by 10 December 2026 and the service has eight weeks, 20 information specialist hours and two part-time reviewers. A rapid review with stated shortcuts (a dated update search from January 2022, single screening with a 20 percent check, English only) can update the existing meta-analysis for function at about three months (claims c1, c2) and summarise adherence (c3), older and digitally excluded patients (c4) and physiotherapist time (c5). Rapid and full reviews usually agree on the direction of effect when shortcuts are reported.
alternatives: Full systematic review (refused: cannot finish before the committee meets)
Summarise the 2023 meta-analysis only (refused: search ended in March 2022 and function for older patients is not addressed)
Local evaluation of a small device batch before any review (deferred: the committee first needs to know whether the evidence justifies spending)
guidelines: PRISMA 2020, with rapid review shortcuts stated
whyNotMoreComplex: A full systematic review with duplicate screening and author contact would take months and is unlikely to change the direction of the answer; the decision needs a dated, transparent update now.

decision.statement: Conduct an eight-week rapid review of wearable activity feedback after total knee replacement, with function at about three months as the primary outcome and adherence, physiotherapist time and results for older patients as secondary questions, and report to the procurement committee on 10 December 2026.
decision.question: Should the centre commission a rapid review before deciding on the wearable lease?

criteria.text: Retrieved evidence shows an effect on the targeted behaviour but leaves the decision-critical outcome uncertain, so an updated synthesis could change the decision.
An up-to-date review already answers the question for patients over 75.

gates.requirement: Information specialist time for the searches
gates.evidence: Library request LIB-2026-311 confirming 20 hours between 5 October and 27 November 2026, supplied by the investigator

gates.requirement: A decision date and forum for the report
gates.evidence: Procurement committee agenda item PC-26-44 for 10 December 2026, supplied by the investigator

alternatives: Full systematic review after the lease decision
decision.note: Rests on ledger claims c1, c2 and c4 from retrieved records; both gates are met on investigator-supplied records.

summary: Rapid review recommended; the decision rests on three ledger claims and both gates are met.
